facts.fact: ARCEP's director general is reported as saying that operator offers reached 995 FCFA per gigabyte in 2023 (from about 4,000 FCFA a gigabyte on average in 2016), a per-gigabyte offer price rather than a monthly plan; the year 2023 is the date of the price and no month is given.

note: The article's USD gigabyte figures (27.22 USD in 2019, 3.62 USD two years later) are internally inconsistent with its FCFA equivalents and are not recorded.
